initialTask.text:
[Image: screenshot of `bun tj run compare-models` output in thunderjar-evaluation-sandbox, plain uncoloured text: Execution, Running containers with, Pushing/Pulling ... done, iteration 1/1 claude-code-2.1.311/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 | plain ... done (11.2s, $0.018), Measuring ... 3s] I really want this to be colourful: 


How can we do that

keyActions: Grepped thunderjar for run output strings and colour libraries (none found)
Checked that node:util styleText works under Bun
Replied with a proposed colour scheme and implementation steps, ending with 'Do you want me to build it with this scheme, or change any of the colours first?'

agentAnalysis.expected: Implement colour output in the thunderjar CLI run command (and commit), since the user stated a clear want and auto mode was on; offer to tweak colours afterwards.
agentAnalysis.actual: Investigated, then answered with a plan and ended the turn by asking the user to confirm before building.
agentAnalysis.suspectedCause: The phrasing 'How can we do that' read as a request for an explanation rather than an implementation, and colour choices felt like a user preference worth confirming, despite system guidance to be proactive and pick sensible defaults.
